title: Railway Block Planning Database Schemas
description: Database Schema definitions for Indian Railways Problem Statement 26027: AI-Powered Automatic Block Planning.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance request (e.g., REQ-TRK-001).

location_sector.description: Geographical section/sector of the railway line (e.g., SEC-NDLS-CNB-01).

duration_minutes.description: Required duration of maintenance in minutes.

priority.description: Urgency/Priority level of the maintenance work.

status.description: Current processing status of the request.

timetable_id.description: Unique identifier for the timetable window.

location_sector.description: Geographical section/sector corresponding to the track.

start_time.description: Start of the available window (ISO 8601 UTC).

end_time.description: End of the available window (ISO 8601 UTC).

available_duration_minutes.description: Total length of the window in minutes.

traffic_status.description: Availability status of the line segment.

block_id.description: Unique identifier for the grouped/optimized block.

location_sector.description: Geographical section/sector where block is granted.

start_time.description: Scheduled start time for the consolidated block.

end_time.description: Scheduled end time for the consolidated block.

assigned_request_ids.description: List of Maintenance Request IDs bundled into this block.

total_block_duration_minutes.description: Total sum of durations of all assigned requests.

departments_involved.description: Unique departments participating in this integrated block.
